title: ARCS NFTT Story Envelope
description: The data envelope for a data-driven ARCS story (Notes-from-the-Trenches class). The essay body stays prose; this schema governs the SYSTEM: threads (palette + names + node shapes), the narrative arc, tier, and metadata. Version 1.

slug.description: URL slug; the post routes at /blog/nftt/<slug>.

tier.description: Depth tier. The depth ladder only links sibling tiers whose files exist.

title.description: Page title; defaults to the first ## heading in the body.

description.description: Meta description; defaults to the title.

threads.description: The braid. Two to N threads. NOT hardcoded: a story picks its own palette, names, and node shapes, which is what makes the template extend past NFTT.

hex.description: Node + stitch color. Must clear AA on the void background.

name.description: Legend label, e.g. 'red · gates'. The word before '·' is matched against stitch openers to color them.

shape.description: Node glyph. Shape carries meaning independent of color (colorblind-safe).

arc.description: Optional narrative arc. Renders horizontally when short and legible; auto-reflows to a vertical ladder past the legibility gate. Omit it entirely if the story has no arc; a data-driven arc is never decoration.

label.description: The beat. Kept short; the ladder gives it a full line.

thread.description: Must reference a declared thread id.
